keyword: how many people have won the masters back to back
claims: As of the conclusion of the 2026 Masters, four golfers have won the Masters tournament back-to-back.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters in 2025.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters in 2026.
Rory McIlroy's 2025 and 2026 wins mark the fourth time in history a player has won consecutive Masters tournaments.
Jack Nicklaus won consecutive Masters tournaments in 1965–1966.
Nick Faldo won consecutive Masters tournaments in 1989–1990.
Tiger Woods won consecutive Masters tournaments in 2001–2002.
Rory McIlroy won consecutive Masters tournaments in 2025–2026.
No player has ever won three consecutive Masters tournaments.
